title: Requesting adjusted working hours
instructions: Write in English in connected paragraphs. Complete all the requested points. Task 1 requires at least 150 words. This is letter preparation, not a full IELTS Writing test.

stimulus.text:
Task 1
You have worked with your manager Ms Rahimi for several months. You plan to begin a part-time course and would like to reduce your working hours. Write a letter to Ms Rahimi. In your letter:
• explain why you want to take the course and reduce your hours
• state the working days and hours you would prefer
• explain how the skills you study could help your employer.
Begin your letter: Dear Ms Rahimi,
Write at least 150 words in connected paragraphs. You do not need to write any addresses. Aim to spend about 20 minutes. Use a semi-formal style.

questions.prompt: Write your letter. Develop every part of all three bullet points and write at least 150 words.

teachingAnchors.label: Build the language first
teachingAnchors.text: Separate a habitual schedule (“I work ...”) from a proposed temporary arrangement (“I would like to work ... until ...”). Connect reason and consequence with because or so, checking that the clause order remains clear. Prefer an accurate request such as “Would it be possible ...?” over an order or an assumed approval.

teachingAnchors.label: Plan for the recipient
teachingAnchors.text: For each bullet, write a short answer and one detail that develops it. Trace the practical connection: why this request or offer, what exactly you propose or describe, and why it matters to the reader. Do not answer a description bullet by repeating a name. Match greeting, request and closing to the stated relationship, and keep invented details plausible and consistent.

teachingAnchors.label: Draft, then check coverage
teachingAnchors.text: Write the complete letter in connected paragraphs. Check every component of each bullet against an actual sentence; a vague mention is not full development. Read time phrases and references aloud to test clarity. Revise one underdeveloped reason and one inaccurate sentence, then explain the changes. Try a fresh independent situation only after reviewing the completed draft.

criteria.label: Task achievement — Task 1
criteria.description: For Task 1 only: clear purpose, appropriate semi-formal relationship and register, with relevant development of every component in the three bullet points, including a concrete proposal or description and a reason connected to the reader; at least 150 words.

criteria.label: Coherence and cohesion
criteria.description: Assess logical progression, purposeful paragraphs and clear referencing/linking within each response; avoid mechanical connector counts.

criteria.label: Lexical resource
criteria.description: Assess accurate, appropriate vocabulary and collocation, flexibility of expression and the effect of spelling or word-formation errors in each response.

criteria.label: Grammatical range and accuracy
criteria.description: Assess control of simple and complex structures, sentence boundaries and punctuation, with attention to errors that obscure meaning in each response.

assessment.feedbackGuidance: After submission only: Private annotated snippets: “I would like to develop my spreadsheet skills through an evening course, but its practical sessions conflict with two of my shifts.” gives purpose and reason. “Could I work Monday to Thursday from nine until three while the course is running?” makes a precise request. “The reporting exercises should help me prepare clearer stock summaries for our team.” connects the proposed study to the employer’s work without promising an unsupported qualification or guaranteed result. Map each bullet and its compound parts to a specific learner span. Diagnose missing content separately from vague development and inappropriate register. Ask the learner to expand one reason into a reason→consequence link and revise one unclear time expression or sentence. Do not require these exemplar details, a memorised letter or real personal information. Comment on Coherence and cohesion, Lexical resource, and Grammatical range and accuracy using actual evidence. Do not supply a band, score, calibrated estimate or official examiner claim.

locale.instructionsFa: به انگلیسی و در بندهای پیوسته بنویسید. همهٔ موارد نامه را پاسخ دهید و دست‌کم ۱۵۰ واژه بنویسید. این تمرین نامه‌نویسی است و آزمون کامل نیست.

teachingAnchorsFa.label: ابتدا زبان
teachingAnchorsFa.text: برنامهٔ همیشگی را از پیشنهاد موقت جدا کنید. برای دلیل و پیامد از because یا so با ترتیب روشن استفاده کنید. زمان شروع، پایان یا مدت را دقیق بنویسید و درخواست را به‌جای دستور یا فرضِ موافقت بیان کنید.

teachingAnchorsFa.label: طرح برای مخاطب
teachingAnchorsFa.text: برای هر مورد، یک پاسخ کوتاه و یک جزئیات بسط‌دهنده بنویسید: چرا این درخواست یا پیشنهاد، دقیقاً چه چیزی، و چه اهمیتی برای مخاطب دارد. نام‌بردن به‌تنهایی توصیف نیست. لحن آغاز، درخواست و پایان با رابطهٔ مخاطب هماهنگ باشد.

teachingAnchorsFa.label: نوشتن و بازبینی
teachingAnchorsFa.text: نامه را کامل و در بندهای پیوسته بنویسید. هر جزء خواسته‌شده را به جمله‌ای مشخص وصل کنید. زمان‌ها و ضمیرها را بخوانید. یک دلیل کم‌توضیح و یک جملهٔ نادرست را اصلاح کنید.

locale.feedbackGuidanceFa: پس از ثبت پاسخ، برای هر جزء خواسته‌شده یک شاهد از نوشته بیابید. نبود محتوا، توضیح ناکافی و لحن نامناسب را جدا بررسی کنید. یک دلیل را به پیامد مرتبط کنید و یک عبارت زمانی یا جمله را اصلاح کنید. بازخورد، نمره یا برآورد معتبر آیلتس نیست.
